targets.direct_cause_statement: The paper does not disclose the random seeds, noise, lower-row generator or SVC regularization needed to reconstruct the six Fig. 5 panels paper-exactly.
targets.root_cause_statement: Fig. 5, six SVC decision maps is scientifically runnable, but the publication omits indispensable benchmark or training metadata; no amount of local rerunning can prove the missing author trajectory.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Obtain the omitted author benchmark/training contract and rerun the frozen implementation without changing scientific arrays to fit the source figure.

targets.direct_cause_statement: The printed universal statement fails without identifying phases modulo 2*pi, and Proposition 1 is false as written even though the corrected finite-set feature-space conclusion is supported.
targets.root_cause_statement: The paper omits the physical phase-domain qualification, states an insufficient affine-separability condition, and uses nonzero pairwise overlaps as an invalid proof of multi-mode linear independence.
targets.next_discriminating_test: A fresh-context reviewer must independently rederive the phase-domain and affine-rank conditions and attempt to falsify both counterexamples without reading the original reproduction discussion.
